problem:
Let $B={{b}_{1},{b}_{2},{b}_{3}}$ be a basis of ${R}^{3}$ and let $T:{R}^{3}\to {R}^{3}$ be a linear transformation. Find $[T(x)]_{B},$ given that
$\,$ $[T]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}3 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 5 & 0 \\ -1 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]\,$ and $\,[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -4 \\ 0\end{aligned}].$

activity_context.topic_title: The Matrix of a Linear Transformation Relative to a Basis

feedback.problem:
Let $B={{b}_{1},{b}_{2}}$ be a basis of ${R}^{2}$ and let $T:{R}^{2}\to {R}^{2}$ be a linear transformation. Find $[T(x)]_{B}$, given that
$\,$ $[T]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}2 & 3 \\ 1 & 4\end{aligned}]\,$ and $\,[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 5\end{aligned}].$
feedback.worked_solution:
The image of $[x]_{B}$ relative to the basis $B$ under the action of the linear transformation $T$ is given by 

$$
\begin{aligned}[T(x)]_{B} & =[T]_{B}[x]_{B} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}2 & 3 \\ 1 & 4\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 5\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}11 \\ 18\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
